Overview

This feature service provides the District of Peachland's Official Community Plan (OCP) future land use layer. It represents planned land use designations used to support community planning, growth management, and development review within Peachland.

Layer

  • PCH Landuse: Polygon features showing future land use designations and related descriptive information for areas within the District of Peachland.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers the District of Peachland in British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Reference future land use designations in planning and policy work
  • Support development permit and land use review processes
  • Use in community planning, growth forecasting, and land management studies
  • Integrate with other municipal and regional planning datasets

Credits and Terms

Owned by the District of Peachland provided by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan and shared under the Regional District of Central Okanagan Open Data License, with applicable disclaimer and terms of use.
